config.selection: Six purposefully selected, source-reproduced numeric criteria on three previously explored public development tasks. Nominal correct value and a single outside-range value. No held-out generalization claim. Numeric notation is fixed across languages. Independent equivalence review pending.
config.primary_analysis: Majority over three repeats per cell. Content detection requires correct=1 and incorrect=0; paraphrase instability is any majority change with response fixed. Report raw denominators and equal-task macro means. Complement with pass-fraction changes and repeat instability; no population intervals with three selected tasks.
